purpose: test a new FX-specific signal family after stopping the V18-V20 currency-network family

indicator.name: H4 Countertrend Sweep Reclaim
indicator.countertrend_m15: h4_direction times log(mid_close_t_minus_1 / mid_close_t_minus_4) is strictly negative
indicator.m5_sweep: bar t-1 trades beyond the opposite-side rail made from completed bars t-13 through t-2
indicator.m5_reclaim: bar t closes back inside that frozen rail and its close-to-close return is in the H4 direction
indicator.entry: next M5 executable BID/ASK open at t+1

rationale: Do not chase a breakout. Treat the short-timeframe break against the H4 context as a possible liquidity sweep and enter only after a completed-bar reclaim in the H4 direction.

evaluation.inventory: same one-position-per-pair opposite-close-only state machine as V16
evaluation.allocation: seven fixed 1/7 sleeves; gross cap 1.0; no leverage tuning
evaluation.period_containment: fill and expiry must both be inside each evaluated period
evaluation.terminal_inventory: always liquidated and required to be zero

development_admission: at least 20 source signals in the full walk and in each standalone month
normal and adverse equity multiples exceed 1.0 in the full walk and each standalone month
multiplicity: Count V21 as the first hypothesis in a new family; opened development evidence is never final admission.
